title: hieracium calcareum subsp. baldense
intro: Hieracium calcareum subsp. baldense, commonly known as the Alpine Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Europe, for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its use in treating conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium calcareum subsp. baldense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety for human consumption.
